workflow.name: Pre-flight Analysis
workflow.trigger: review plan, critique proposal, before we start, sanity check, validate approach, check plan
workflow.description: Critical analysis of plans and proposals BEFORE any implementation begins.

step.goal: Analyze the proposed plan/strategy for: - Gaps in coverage or missing considerations - Risk exposure and failure modes - Anti-patterns or known pitfalls - Unnecessary overhead or complexity
Assess strategic alignment and architectural soundness. Identify scope drift from original intent. Evaluate feasibility and hidden dependencies. Provide go/revise/no-go recommendation with rationale.
